purpose: Qualitative demand/friction intelligence for separated-parent child maintenance. Scores are not measured search volumes and do not prove eligibility or a private payment obligation. Current Försäkringskassan primary sources carry truth-bearing rules; community discussion and natural problem formulations are discovery signals only.

scoring.priority_rule: Prioritize combinations of high demand, high friction, high consequence and weak current product coverage; these scores are not measured search volumes.

natural_language_queries: den andra föräldern betalar inget vad gör jag
barnet bor mest hos mig kan jag få underhållsstöd
barnet bor varannan vecka ska någon betala underhåll
den andra föräldern betalar bara en del av underhållet
den andra föräldern bor utomlands vem hjälper med underhåll

demand_signal.basis: Försäkringskassan maintains a dedicated national section with separate current routes for how maintenance works, missing payment, payer responsibilities and cross-border cases. The agency also publishes dedicated statistics for maintenance support. This is a qualitative reach signal, not measured search volume.

friction_signal.basis: People can easily conflate underhållsbidrag paid directly between parents with underhållsstöd from Försäkringskassan, assume separation or nonpayment alone proves eligibility, or treat equal residence as either automatic support or proof that maintenance can never be relevant.

miss_consequence.basis: Choosing the wrong route can delay support for a child, create avoidable conflict between parents, or make a user rely on an incorrect private payment assumption.

source_fragmentation.basis: Core truth is concentrated at Försäkringskassan, but the correct next page depends on residence pattern, payment status and whether a parent lives abroad; disagreement may additionally involve municipal collaboration talks or legal help.

language_accessibility_friction.basis: The distinction between underhållsbidrag, underhållsstöd, växelvist boende, partial payment and cross-border help is terminology-heavy and difficult to translate into a concrete next action without overclaiming.

steps_to_action.basis: A safe path first distinguishes residence and payment status, then selects direct maintenance, state-support verification or cross-border guidance before any material eligibility or amount question is considered.

recurrence_signal.basis: Recurring community questions about whether contact/residence patterns reduce or eliminate maintenance show durable misunderstanding. Community content is used only to discover the confusion pattern; Försäkringskassan remains the sole truth-bearing source in this signal.

current_product_coverage_gap.basis: The public product already had family, VAB and school-support routes but no focused natural-language route that separates direct maintenance from state maintenance support or preserves equal-residence and cross-border boundaries.

signals.recommended_learning_action: Extend the same root/person product with focus=child_maintenance. Ask residence pattern before payment only when those facts are missing, preserve equal-residence and cross-border branches, and keep custody, registration, insurance, amount, retroactivity and individual legal obligations review-gated in the primary-source layer.
signals.truth_rule: VERIFY material rules against current Försäkringskassan primary sources. Do not infer that separation or nonpayment alone proves underhållsstöd eligibility, equal residence means maintenance can never be relevant, partial payment guarantees a specific state top-up, or a foreign residence case follows identical administrative steps in every country.
